status: snapshot-consistent retrospective sensitivity study; creation is not verified public release
target: Salmonella positivity in selected FSIS raw-poultry primary samples; not consumer illness
feature_availability: Training labels are frozen to earlier source snapshots and are not updated using held-out outcomes. Calendar month is known at the selected sample date. Metadata creation dates precede validation collection dates; first public release and row-level result availability are unverified. No availability dates were invented.
operational_selection: Frozen smoothed historical prevalence remains the transparent estimator; this sensitivity study does not validate prospective deployment.
limitations: The FY2024/FY2025 files were created March 19, 2026, but that is not proof they were publicly released or accessible on that day.
FY2026 outcomes come from an October 9, 2026 snapshot and may contain retrospective revisions; no historical as-of archive was supplied.
Sampling schedules and publication latency are unknown, so this evaluates selected future-dated samples conditional on being sampled.
Single later-date holdout; no evidence of transportability to farms, shipments or consumers.
No held-out labels enter frozen model parameters or historical prevalence.
No CDC surveillance or weather feature is joined to this target.
Intervals resample validation weeks and exclude publication-lag and selection uncertainty.

availability_audit.original_evaluation_status: Existing 90-day-lag evaluation remains retrospective feasibility; 90 days is an assumption, not measured latency.
